opening.argument: The video presents a first-person account of autism, workplace inclusion, and practical support through JPMorgan Chase's Autism at Work programme. The speaker explains that sensory input can be intense, identifies her role in wholesale client onboarding, and describes how support was put in place after diagnosis. She says, "The Autism at Work programme changed my life" and expresses hope that autistic people receive similar opportunities. The office setting and branded end card reinforce this workplace context. A visible subscribe prompt is ordinary audience engagement; nothing presented requests payment, investment, credentials, or deceptive participation.

citations.quote: Once I did get my diagnosis then I was put in touch with the Autism at Work Programme and that's when the support really got put into place.
I work in the wholesale client onboarding department.
The Autism at Work programme changed my life and I would love for every autistic person to have the opportunities I have today
